div.div: The worker uses CLAIMED / SEND_STARTED / RETRYABLE / ACCEPTED / SIMULATED / UNKNOWN / FAILED receipt states. Receipts use an HMAC-derived recipient ID, record the operation and key version, and contain no raw name or email. UNKNOWN outcomes require reconciliation or a deliberate retry policy.

div.div: Important: Service Bus is at-least-once; it does not make email exactly-once. Use {release_id}/{operation_id}/{key_version}/{HMAC_key(normalized_email)} receipts, conditional Blob writes, bounded retries, DLQ handling and reconciliation of ambiguous SendGrid outcomes.
